mentions.name: Heaven.dev
mentions.description: Heaven.dev is a cloud platform that provides completely persistent Linux computers sharing a group of pooled resources (CPU, RAM, storage), so resources can be allocated across workloads. It is designed around the principle of transmutability — computers and resources can be reshaped to match any workload — giving AI coding agents freedom over computers and resources instead of the restrictive traditional cloud infrastructure.
mentions.problem: Current cloud infrastructure is extremely restrictive for the new tasks and ways of working that coding agents open.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on Heaven.dev for the past couple months.

https://heaven.dev/

It's a cloud where you get completely persistent Linux computers that share a group of resources (CPU, RAM, Storage). This means that you're able to allocate resources across workloads which has a ton of benefits when working with agents.
